meta.format: 10-team dynasty, superflex, half-PPR, TE premium, weekly median game

playoff_picture.note: Each week has two results: head-to-head and versus the league median.

transactions.grading_note: Trade grades use TODAY's dynasty values, in hindsight: net = value received minus value given.

players_to_watch.note: Rostered players only. Rookie = first NFL season. Breakout = 15+ points this week from a player who averaged under 10 before. New starter = in a starting lineup this week after at most one start in this league earlier this season. started_this_week=false means the points were on a bench.

rookie_watch.note: Rookies selected in this league's rookie drafts. Value changes are 30-day FantasyCalc trends.

dynasty_market.note: 30-day value movement for players on league rosters (FantasyCalc, superflex).
dynasty_market.candidate_rules: Sell-high: rising value on an aging player (RB 26+, others 28+) worth 2,000+. Buy-low: falling value on a player 25 or younger who is still worth 2,500+.

next_week.note: form_projection = average of season scoring average and last-3-weeks average. It is a simple form guide, not a real projection.
